verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sabadh surat saadh sa(n)g mil bhaan giaan jot ko udhot pragaTaio hai ||

en.bdb: An obedient Sikh of the Guru unites the divine word with his consciousness in the company of saintly persons. That illuminates a light of Guru's knowledge in his mind

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਭ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਛਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naabh saravar bikhai braham kamal dhal hoi prafulit bimal jal chhaio hai ||

en.bdb: As a lotus flower blooms with the rise of the Sun, so does the lotus in the navel-region pond of a Sikh of the Guru blossoms with the rising of the Sun of Guru's knowledge that helps him make spiritual progress. Meditation of Naam then progresses with every breath.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਿਪੂਰਨ ਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: madh makara(n)dh ras prem paripooran kai man madhukar sukh sa(n)paT samaio hai ||

en.bdb: With the development as described above, the bumble beelike mind absorbs in the peace-giving fragrant elixir of Naam captured by love. He is engrossed in the bliss of Naam Simran.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੋਦ ਅਮੋਦ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੋਦ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੭॥
verses.translit_en: akath kathaa binodh modh amodh liv unaman hoi manodh anat na dhaio hai ||257||

en.bdb: The description of the ecstatic state of a Guru oriented person absorbed in His name is beyond words. Intoxicated in this higher spiritual state, his mind does not wander anywhere else. (257)
